annotations.title: No Surprises Act IDR: a filer's or payer's scorecard

description: The Q4 2025 IDR scorecard of one filing organization (provider email domain, e.g. fam-llc.com, qmacsmso.com, usap.com, halomd.com) or payer (uhc.com, bcbstx.com, aetna.com): disputes, win rate against the 85% provider norm, arbitrator fees paid on losses, overreach and under-ask shares, money left on the table at the norm, worst cells against the cell norm, arbitrator mix with loss rate per entity; for payers, the concede cells where providers win 90%+. With no domain: the arbitrator propensity table and the lists of filers and payers with 500+ disputes. Free. The full calibration file is sold by invoice.
